privacy_page.title: Privacy Notice — Fake GPS
privacy_page.heading: Privacy Notice
privacy_page.section_1_title: 1. Responsible for the processing of personal data
privacy_page.section_1_text: The developer of the Fake GPS application (hereinafter "the Application") is responsible for the use, management and protection of the personal data collected through it, in compliance with the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties and its regulations.
privacy_page.section_2_text_1: The Application does not collect, store or share the user's personal information, such as name, email, phone number or real location.
privacy_page.section_2_text_2: During operation, the application may request mock location permissions to fulfill its primary purpose. This data is only used locally on the user's device.
privacy_page.section_3_text_1: The requested permissions are used exclusively to:
privacy_page.section_3_item_1: Simulate geographic locations for development, testing, or demonstration purposes.
privacy_page.section_3_item_2: Improve the user experience within the device environment.
privacy_page.section_3_text_2: At no time is the data used to identify, track or monitor the user.
privacy_page.section_4_text: The Application does not transfer or sell information to third parties. All information remains within the device and under the user's control.
privacy_page.section_5_text: If you integrate external services (for example, APIs or map SDKs), these services may have their own privacy notices. The user must consult and accept the corresponding policies of each provider.
privacy_page.section_6_text: Technical and administrative measures are implemented to protect local data and prevent unauthorized access or misuse of information within the device.
privacy_page.section_7_title: 7. ARCO Rights (Access, Rectification, Cancellation and Opposition)
privacy_page.section_7_text: Since the Application does not collect or store personal data, the exercise of these rights does not apply. However, the user can uninstall the application at any time, deleting all the local information generated.
privacy_page.section_8_text: The developer may modify this notice to adapt it to legal or functional changes to the application. Updates will be available within the application or in its official publication.
